repos.description: :cn: GitHub中文排行榜，各语言分设「软件 | 资料」榜单，精准定位中文好项目。各取所需，高效学习。
repos.summary_zh: GitHub中文排行榜是一个按编程语言分类的中文开源项目榜单，涵盖软件与资料两类，提供总榜、增速榜和新秀榜，帮助开发者高效发现优质中文开源项目，降低语言障碍，提升学习效率。
repos.summary_en: GitHub Chinese Top Charts is a categorized ranking system of high-quality Chinese open-source projects by programming language, featuring software and knowledge categories, with overall, growth, and new repo rankings to help developers discover and learn from top Chinese projects efficiently.

repos.description: Turn any idea, plan, or codebase into a beautiful interactive diagram. An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex, and more.
repos.summary_zh: Archify是一款AI代理技能，可将自然语言描述即时转化为可交互的自包含HTML可视化图表，支持架构图、工作流、序列图、数据流等类型，内置动画效果与简洁导出，无缝集成Cursor、Claude Code等主流AI编程工具。
repos.summary_en: Archify is an AI agent skill that instantly converts natural language descriptions into interactive self-contained HTML visualizations, supporting architecture diagrams, workflows, sequence diagrams, and data flows with built-in animations and clean export. It integrates seamlessly with Cursor, Claude Code, and other major AI coding tools.

repos.description: Apache ECharts is a powerful, interactive charting and data visualization library for browser
repos.summary_zh: Apache ECharts 是一个强大的开源数据可视化库，基于纯 JavaScript 和 zrender 构建，支持丰富的交互式图表（如折线图、柱状图、热力图等），提供高度可定制的配置选项，适用于商业产品中的数据可视化需求，支持 npm 安装、CDN 引入及多语言文档。
repos.summary_en: Apache ECharts is a free, powerful charting and visualization library for browsers, built with pure JavaScript and zrender. It offers intuitive, interactive, and highly customizable charts for commercial products, with support for npm, CDN, and comprehensive documentation.

repos.description: :fireworks:Interactive Online Platform that Visualizes Algorithms from Code
repos.summary_zh: Algorithm Visualizer 是一个交互式在线平台，通过可视化代码将算法动态呈现，帮助学习者和开发者直观理解算法执行过程。支持多种编程语言，提供丰富的教程与可视化效果，适用于教学与算法研究。
repos.summary_en: Algorithm Visualizer is an interactive online platform that brings algorithms to life through code visualization. It supports multiple programming languages and offers engaging educational content, making algorithm learning intuitive and effective for students and professionals.

repos.description: A visual no-code/code-free web crawler/spider易采集：一个可视化浏览器自动化测试/数据采集/网页爬虫软件，可以无代码图形化的设计和执行爬虫任务。别名：ServiceWrapper面向Web应用的智能化服务封装系统。
repos.summary_zh: 易采集/EasySpider 是一款完全免费的视觉无代码浏览器自动化工具，支持图形化设计爬虫任务，无需编程即可实现网页数据采集与自动化测试。通过可视化操作选择网页元素，自动识别同类内容并批量采集，同时支持命令行模式嵌入其他系统，适用于电商、数据抓取等场景。
repos.summary_en: EasySpider is a completely free visual no-code web crawler and browser automation tool that enables users to design and execute data collection tasks through a graphical interface without programming. It automatically detects similar elements on web pages, supports batch data extraction, and can also run via command line for integration into other systems, ideal for e-commerce scraping and automation testing.

repos.summary_zh: WeChatMsg 是一个微信聊天记录导出与分析工具，支持将聊天记录导出为多种格式（如 Excel、HTML），并提供可视化分析功能。项目强调个人数据主权，倡导用户自主管理生活痕迹，未来计划结合 AI 技术构建个人记忆数据中心，实现智能相册与年度报告生成。
repos.summary_en: WeChatMsg is a WeChat chat export and analysis tool that supports exporting chats to formats like Excel and HTML with visualization features. It emphasizes personal data ownership, enabling users to manage their digital footprints. The project aims to integrate AI for building personal memory data centers, including smart photo albums and annual report generation.

repos.description: A powerful 🚀 Android chart view / graph view library, supporting line- bar- pie- radar- bubble- and candlestick charts as well as scaling, panning and animations.
repos.summary_zh: MPAndroidChart 是一个功能强大且易于使用的 Android 图表库，支持折线图、柱状图、饼图、雷达图、气泡图和 K 线图等多种图表类型，具备缩放、平移和动画功能，适用于数据可视化场景。
repos.summary_en: MPAndroidChart is a powerful and easy-to-use Android chart library supporting line, bar, pie, radar, bubble, and candlestick charts with scaling, panning, and animations for data visualization.

repos.description: A next.js web application that integrates AI capabilities with draw.io diagrams. This app allows you to create, modify, and enhance diagrams through natural language commands and AI-assisted visualization.
repos.summary_zh: Next AI Draw.io 是一个基于 Next.js 的 AI 驱动图表设计工具，通过自然语言指令与 AI 辅助可视化，支持创建、修改和增强 draw.io 风格的流程图与架构图，集成多模态 AI 能力与云服务商图标库。
repos.summary_en: Next AI Draw.io is a Next.js-based web app that integrates AI capabilities with draw.io diagrams, enabling users to create, modify, and enhance diagrams via natural language commands and AI-assisted visualization, featuring multi-cloud icon support and real-time diagram generation.

repos.description: Python资源大全中文版，包括：Web框架、网络爬虫、模板引擎、数据库、数据可视化、图片处理等，由「开源前哨」和「Python开发者」微信公号团队维护更新。
repos.summary_zh: jobbole/awesome-python-cn 是 Python 资源大全的中文镜像仓库，涵盖 Web 框架、网络爬虫、数据库、数据可视化、机器学习等全领域工具链。由开源社区维护，提供分类清晰的资源列表，助力开发者快速定位高质量 Python 生态组件。
repos.summary_en: jobbole/awesome-python-cn is the Chinese mirror of Python's comprehensive resource repository, covering tools across Web frameworks, web scraping, databases, data visualization, machine learning, and more. Maintained by open-source communities, it offers a well-organized catalog of high-quality Python ecosystem components for developers.

repos.description: Visualize any GitHub codebase: free interactive architecture diagrams and one-minute explainer videos. Replace 'hub' with 'diagram' in any GitHub URL.
repos.summary_zh: GitDiagram 是一款免费的交互式 GitHub 仓库可视化工具，可将任意仓库结构秒级转换为系统架构图。支持点击组件跳转源码、导出 Mermaid 代码或 PNG 图片，集成 OpenAI GPT-5.2 实现智能分析，提供私有仓库支持与自托管部署方案，适用于快速理解复杂代码库。
repos.summary_en: GitDiagram is a free, fast tool that converts any GitHub repository into interactive architecture diagrams in seconds. It leverages OpenAI GPT-5.2 for intelligent analysis, supports clickable navigation to source files, exports Mermaid/PNG formats, and offers private repo support with self-hosting capabilities for deep codebase understanding.

repos.description: Create web-based user interfaces with Python. The nice way.
repos.summary_zh: NiceGUI是一个基于Python的轻量级Web UI框架，通过纯Python代码快速构建按钮、图表、3D场景等交互界面。内置热重载、定时器刷新与数据绑定，支持浏览器访问与原生桌面模式，适用于仪表板、机器人控制和ML调参等场景。
repos.summary_en: NiceGUI is a lightweight Python-based framework for building interactive web UIs with buttons, charts, and 3D scenes. It features auto-reload, timers, data binding, and supports both browser and desktop modes—ideal for dashboards, robotics, and ML tuning.

repos.description: 🎨 Python Echarts Plotting Library
repos.summary_zh: pyecharts 是一个基于 Apache ECharts 的 Python 数据可视化库，提供简洁流畅的 API 设计，支持 30+ 种常见图表类型，兼容 Jupyter 系列 Notebook 和主流 Web 框架（如 Flask、Django），支持链式调用与高度灵活配置，内置 400+ 地图文件，适用于地理数据可视化，当前主推 V1/V2 版本（Python 3.7+）。
repos.summary_en: pyecharts is a Python data visualization library built on Apache ECharts, offering fluent API design with 30+ chart types, seamless integration with Jupyter notebooks and web frameworks like Flask/Django, chainable syntax, extensive map support (400+), and flexible configuration, targeting Python 3.7+ in V1/V2 versions.

repos.description: A persistent service that generates mock data quickly and provids visualization view.
repos.summary_zh: Easy Mock 是一个快速生成模拟数据并提供可视化界面的持久化服务，支持团队协作、Swagger 导入、Mock.js 语法及自定义响应配置，适用于前后端分离开发中的接口模拟与测试。
repos.summary_en: Easy Mock is a persistent service that quickly generates mock data with a visualization interface, supporting team collaboration, Swagger import, Mock.js schema, and customizable responses for frontend-backend development and API testing.

repos.description: 🦋 An Infographic Generation and Rendering Framework, bring words to life with AI!
repos.summary_zh: AntV Infographic 是蚂蚁集团 AntV 团队推出的下一代声明式信息图可视化引擎，提供约200个内置模板和组件，支持AI友好语法配置，可快速生成高质量SVG信息图，具备主题系统、内置编辑器和数据叙事能力，适用于数据可视化与内容创作场景。
repos.summary_en: AntV Infographic is AntV's next-generation declarative infographic visualization engine, offering ~200 built-in templates and components. It supports AI-friendly syntax for rapid generation of high-quality SVG infographics, featuring a theme system, built-in editor, and data storytelling capabilities for visualization and content creation.

repos.description: Native Proxy Experience Built for macOS
repos.summary_zh: ClashMac 是一款专为 macOS 打造的本地代理客户端，采用 SwiftUI 原生开发，深度集成系统。提供航线地图、连接拓扑和流量统计三大核心可视化功能，支持系统代理与 TUN 增强模式，具备菜单栏常驻、隐私模式、实时切换和自动重连等特性，带来直观高效的代理管理体验。
repos.summary_en: ClashMac is a native macOS proxy client built with SwiftUI, offering route map visualization, connection topology, and real-time traffic statistics. It supports system proxy and TUN modes, features menu bar integration, privacy mode, instant node switching, and auto-reconnection for an intuitive proxy management experience.

repos.description: curl statistics made simple
repos.summary_zh: httpstat 是一个简洁高效的命令行工具，用于可视化 curl 请求的详细统计信息，包括 DNS 解析、TCP 连接、TLS 握手、HTTP 请求和响应等关键阶段耗时。它用 Python 编写，单文件无依赖，支持丰富的环境变量配置，适用于网络调试和性能分析。
repos.summary_en: httpstat is a simple yet powerful command-line tool that visualizes detailed curl request statistics, including DNS lookup, TCP handshake, TLS negotiation, and HTTP request/response timings. Written in single-file Python with zero dependencies, it offers rich customization via environment variables for network debugging and performance analysis.

repos.description: ⭐This is a lightweight kit for generating astrolabes for Zi Wei Dou Shu (The Purple Star Astrology), an ancient Chinese astrology. It allows you to obtain your horoscope and personality analysis. 支持多语言轻量级获取紫微斗数排盘信息的javascript开源库。
repos.summary_zh: iztro 是一个轻量级紫微斗数排盘 JavaScript 库，支持多语言输入输出，可生成星盘数据、生肖星座、四柱运限及四化分析，提供链式调用和插件扩展，适用于个人命理分析、文化应用开发及学术研究。
repos.summary_en: iztro is a lightweight JavaScript library for generating Zi Wei Dou Shu astrolabes, supporting multi-language input/output, star charts, zodiac signs, four pillars, luck cycles, and four transformations. It offers chainable APIs, plugin extensibility, and is ideal for astrology apps, cultural tools, and research.

repos.description: Visual Skills Pack for Obsidian: generate Canvas, Excalidraw, and Mermaid diagrams from text with Claude Code
repos.summary_zh: Obsidian Visual Skills Pack 是一个实验性插件，通过 Claude Code 将文本自动转换为 Excalidraw（手绘风格）、Mermaid（流程图）和 Canvas（彩色卡片布局）三种可视化图表。支持中文文本处理、动画生成及多输出模式，适用于思维导图、流程设计、系统架构等场景，显著提升知识表达效率。
repos.summary_en: The Obsidian Visual Skills Pack is an experimental plugin that uses Claude Code to automatically convert text into three types of visual diagrams: Excalidraw (hand-drawn style), Mermaid (flowcharts), and Canvas (colorful card layout). It supports Chinese text, animations, multiple output modes, and is ideal for mind maps, workflows, and system architecture visualization.

repos.description: A smart, powerful, and beautiful excalidraw drawing tool.Draw Professional Charts with Natural Language
repos.summary_zh: Smart Excalidraw 是一款基于自然语言的专业图表生成工具，集成 AI 大模型与 Excalidraw 画布，支持 20+ 种图表类型（如流程图、架构图、ER 图等），通过独创连接算法优化布局，用户仅需描述需求即可自动生成可编辑的专业级图表，支持本地部署与服务器端 LLM 配置，兼顾易用性与隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: Smart Excalidraw is an AI-powered diagramming tool that generates professional charts from natural language descriptions. It integrates with Excalidraw canvas, supports 20+ chart types (e.g., flowcharts, architecture diagrams, ER diagrams), uses an innovative connection algorithm for optimal layout, and allows users to edit AI-generated diagrams in real-time. Supports local deployment and server-side LLM configuration for enterprise use.

repos.description: 🚀 A statistical analysis tool for performance testing
repos.summary_zh: Hiper 是一款专为性能测试设计的统计分析工具，支持通过 Chrome 浏览器自动化采集页面加载时间、DNS 查询、TCP 连接等关键性能指标，提供详细的统计报告与可视化分析，适用于 Web 性能监控与优化。
repos.summary_en: Hiper is a statistical analysis tool for performance testing that automates Chrome browser interactions to collect key metrics like DNS lookup, TCP connection, and page load times, delivering detailed reports and visualizations for web performance monitoring and optimization.

repos.description: 中文手绘技术 PPT 整页图像生成 Skill | 21:9 封面 + 16:9 正文配图 | PNG 输出
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是一个 Codex Skill，用于将文章、课程笔记等内容转化为风格统一的中文手绘技术解释图。支持生成 21:9 封面与 16:9 正文 PNG 图像，强调内容叙事规划与视觉一致性，适用于技术文章配图、课件制作和知识卡片生成，推荐使用 ChatGPT Image 2.0 模型以保证输出质量。
repos.summary_en: This Codex Skill transforms articles, course notes, or outlines into stylistically consistent Chinese hand-drawn technical illustration images. It generates 21:9 cover images and 16:9 content pages in PNG format, emphasizing narrative planning and visual coherence. Ideal for technical articles, courseware, and knowledge cards, it recommends ChatGPT Image 2.0 for optimal output quality.

repos.description: 归藏的材质插画 skill：生成带字解释图、图表美化和参考辅助配图。
repos.summary_zh: 歸藏的材质插画 Skill 是专为 AI Agent（如 Claude Code/Codex）设计的配图工具，核心解决文章、PPT 及社交卡片中“中心配图”的生成难题。它通过材质化 3D 风格，将抽象概念、数据图表及工作流程转化为带中文标签的解释图、美化图表及参考辅助图，强调信息传达的准确性与视觉的专业性，适配从小红书卡片到教学材料的多种场景。
repos.summary_en: Guizang Material Illustration Skill is an AI Agent-native tool for generating explanatory center graphics. It transforms abstract concepts, data charts, and workflows into labeled 3D material-style illustrations, beautified charts, and reference-assisted visuals. Focusing on information accuracy and Swiss editorial aesthetics, it supports various scenarios from social media cards to educational content.

repos.description: 一款基于 AI 技术的 Web 应用程序，可将文本内容智能转换为 Mermaid 格式的代码，并将其渲染成可视化图表。
repos.summary_zh: Smart Mermaid 是一款基于 AI 的 Web 应用，可将自然语言文本智能转换为 Mermaid 图表代码并实时渲染。支持流程图、序列图等多种图表类型，提供标准 SVG 与手绘风格双渲染器，具备 AI 代码修复、优化及文件导入功能，适合快速生成可视化图表。
repos.summary_en: Smart Mermaid is an AI-powered web app that converts natural language text into Mermaid diagram code and renders it visually. It supports multiple chart types, dual rendering modes (SVG and hand-drawn), AI-assisted code fixing/optimization, and file import, enabling efficient text-to-diagram conversion for technical documentation and planning.

repos.description: Agent skill that draws architecture, flowchart, sequence, data-flow and lifecycle diagrams as hand-placed SVG, to one linted house style.
repos.summary_zh: SVG 手绘风格架构图绘制技能，为 AI 编码代理提供统一的布局算术、颜色系统与零依赖校验器，支持 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等 40+ 代理，确保生成的序列图、数据流图、生命周期图经 svg-lint 12 项检查后保持 house 样式一致。
repos.summary_en: An agent skill that draws hand-crafted SVG diagrams — architecture, flowchart, sequence, data-flow, lifecycle — following a unified house style with layout arithmetic, a color system, and a zero-dependency linter (svg-lint) with 12 checks. Works with 40+ AI coding agents including Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot.

repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过 ISBN 空间可视化技术，将全球图书数据映射为二维空间，支持按出版社、稀有度等维度进行交互式探索。基于预处理的 ISBN 前缀数据和图书馆馆藏信息，生成高分辨率 PNG 瓦片数据集，适用于大规模图书数据的直观分析与展示。
repos.summary_en: This project visualizes the global book catalog by mapping ISBNs into a 2D space, enabling interactive exploration by publisher, rarity, and other dimensions. It uses preprocessed ISBN prefix data and library holdings to generate high-resolution PNG tile datasets for intuitive analysis and visualization of massive book collections.

repos.description: 一个简单的网络分析跟踪器和仪表板，在 Cloudflare Pages 上即可快速部署的网站分析仪表板,无成本稳定运行
repos.summary_zh: Han-Analytics 是一个基于 Cloudflare Pages 的无服务器网站分析工具，提供轻量级网络跟踪与可视化仪表板功能，支持零成本部署、高并发访问（每日10万次免费统计），具备密码保护和网站白名单等安全特性，适用于个人或企业快速集成网站数据分析。
repos.summary_en: Han-Analytics is a serverless web analytics tool built on Cloudflare Pages, offering lightweight tracking and dashboard visualization with zero-cost deployment, high-concurrency support (up to 100k daily free stats), password protection, and website whitelisting for secure data collection and analysis.

repos.description: ThinkFlow AI 是一个轻量级“从想法到结构化图谱”的工作台：输入一个核心想法，应用会把它扩展为可浏览的知识图谱（模块/子模块）。每个节点支持继续追问扩展、深挖详情，以及可选的配图生成。
repos.summary_zh: ThinkFlow AI 是一个轻量级‘从想法到结构化图谱’工作台，支持输入核心概念自动生成可交互知识图谱。具备AI驱动发散扩展、深度内容挖掘、视觉配图生成、沉浸式演示模式等功能，采用Vue 3 + Vite 5 + @vue-flow/core技术栈，实现本地优先的零平台锁定体验。
repos.summary_en: ThinkFlow AI is a lightweight 'idea-to-structured-graph' workspace that transforms core concepts into interactive knowledge graphs. Features AI-driven divergence expansion, deep content mining, visual image generation, immersive presentation mode, and local-first architecture with zero platform lock-in. Built with Vue 3 + Vite 5 + @vue-flow/core stack.

repos.description: 著名紫薇排盘工具iztro的python版本，用法和原版完全一致
repos.summary_zh: py-iztro 是著名紫微排盘工具 iztro 的 Python 版本，完全复刻原版功能，支持通过公历日期和性别生成详细的紫微斗数命盘，包含星曜分布、五行局等信息，采用 pydantic 进行数据建模，确保类型安全与代码可维护性。
repos.summary_en: py-iztro is a Python reimplementation of the renowned iztro astrology tool, offering identical functionality to the original JavaScript version. It generates comprehensive Ziwei Dou Shu charts using solar dates and gender, with full Pydantic-based data modeling for type safety and maintainability.
